definitions.explanation: A formal written word for Japan, used from a Japanese point of view in official documents, statistics and announcements.

examples.japanese: {本邦|ほんぽう}⟦{初|はつ}{公開|こうかい}→初公開：18413_hatsukoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a film being shown in Japan for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本邦|ほんぽう}⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This will be the first time the work is exhibited in Japan.

examples.japanese: {本邦|ほんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of foreigners living in Japan has risen greatly over the past ten years.

notes:
USAGE:
Mostly met in set phrases on posters and in formal writing; it sounds stiff in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本邦|ほんぽう}⟦{初|はつ}{公開|こうかい}→初公開：18413_hatsukoukai⟧: first showing in Japan (films, artworks)
- {本邦|ほんぽう}⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧: the first in Japan
- {本邦|ほんぽう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: Japanese companies (official, financial writing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我|わ}が{国|くに}→我が国：13449_wagakuni⟧: our country; formal, used by politicians and in editorials
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧: within the country, domestic; the everyday word
